frontier_definition: For each fixed auxiliary bit budget b in {0,...,6}, minimize the number of atomic deleted-card fields among {e1,...,e9,tree} required for global injectivity on the complete n=10 non-isomorphic simple-graph catalog. Auxiliary channels in lower-bound impossibility statements may be arbitrary deterministic b-bit channels; upper bounds use either explicit channels or finite-catalog class-rank channels as stated.

exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.lower_bound: V75: all atomic subsets of size <=4 are globally incomplete.
exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.upper_bound: V75: five inclusion-minimal complete 5-field subsets exist.

exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.lower_bound: V96: all 45 atomic pairs have explicit collision class size >=3, so arbitrary 1 bit cannot repair any pair.
exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.upper_bound: V94: e2+e4+e6 plus one explicit mod-127-derived bit is globally injective.

exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.lower_bound: V98: all 45 atomic pairs have certified collision class size >=5, so arbitrary 2 bits cannot repair any pair.
exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.upper_bound: V92/V98: e2+e4+tree has exact maximum class 4.

exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.lower_bound: V90/V90.1: unique-best single field e4 still needs 57 states, so 8 states cannot repair any single field.
exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.upper_bound: V100: e2+e6 has exact maximum class 7.

exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.lower_bound: V90/V90.1: every single field needs at least 57 states; 16 states are insufficient.
exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.upper_bound: V91: e2+e4 has exact maximum class 10.

exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.lower_bound: V90/V90.1: every single field needs at least 57 states; 32 states are insufficient.
exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.upper_bound: V91: e2+e4 has exact maximum class 10.

exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.lower_bound: With zero atomic fields, a 6-bit channel has only 64 outputs for 12,005,168 graphs, so injectivity is impossible.
exact_frontier_0_to_6_bits.upper_bound: V90/V90.1: e4 exact maximum class is 57 <=64.

constructive_highlights.one_bit_explicit: e2+e4+e6 plus V94 h(G), with r=(sum_v e7(G-v)^2 - 8*sum_v tree(G-v)) mod 127 and fixed residue-coloring mask.

proof_dependency_map.V90.1: correct generic class-rank proof using full V83 globally-injective key F; numerical single-field results unchanged
proof_dependency_map.V92: triple max 2 for e2+e4+e5/e6; e2+e4+tree exact max 4
proof_dependency_map.V96: all pairs + arbitrary 1 bit impossible; min fields at 1 bit =3
proof_dependency_map.V98: all pairs + arbitrary 2 bits impossible; min fields at 2 bits =3
proof_dependency_map.V100: e2+e6 exact max 7; min fields at 3 bits =2

claim_safe_statements: On the complete finite n=10 catalog and within the explicit atomic deleted-card family {e1,...,e9,tree}, the exact minimum atomic-field counts for auxiliary budgets b=0,...,6 are [5,3,3,2,2,2,1].
The first auxiliary-bit budget that permits a two-field atomic base is exactly 3 bits; e2+e6 achieves this with maximum collision class 7.
The first auxiliary-bit budget that permits a single atomic field is exactly 6 bits; e4 achieves this with maximum collision class 57.
With one auxiliary bit, three atomic fields are necessary and sufficient; V94 gives an explicit finite-n=10 realization on e2+e4+e6.
do_not_claim: No statement here proves a general graph-isomorphism algorithm or complexity bound.
No statement here resolves the Reconstruction Conjecture.
No statement here is proved for n>10.
The frontier is relative to the explicit atomic family {e1,...,e9,tree}.
Novelty/priority relative to the literature is not established by these certificates alone.
